references.text: God commanded Moses to go up with Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel as preparation for this ascent.
Nadab and Abihu are mentioned as Aaron's sons, the same ones who went up the mountain with Moses.
Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu are mentioned together as priests called to serve the Lord.
Nadab and Abihu, who here went up the mountain, later died when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
The seventy elders are also mentioned here as chosen leaders in Israel, consistent with the seventy elders who went up the mountain.
Reference to the death of Nadab and Abihu, the same ones who here were granted the privilege of going up the mountain with Moses.
Ezekiel also saw a vision of God's glory, similar to what Moses and the elders experienced on the mountain.
Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a high mountain, a parallel to Moses taking chosen leaders up Sinai.
Same event: The calling (v.1) leads directly to the ascent and the covenant conclusion (v.9).
